title: Production Engineering Associate Manager, Body in White, Data Center Manufacturing
description:
**What to Expect**
Tesla Energy is looking for an exceptional Engineering Leader for its Megapod Body in White (BIW) operations. This role requires a strong technical contributor who can both execute and lead – balancing hands\-on engineering work with building a high performing team. Role responsibilities include end\-to\-end ownership of overall equipment efficiency (OEE), development of mechanisms to foster continuous improvement, and performance management of teams.  

**What You'll Do*** Develop and motivate a high performing team of exceptional engineers, technicians, and leaders in Tesla’s mission to transition the world towards sustainable energy
* Lead engineers and technicians which include, but not limited to equipment, controls, process, and maintenance functions
* Provide support for new equipment installation, startup, and transition to sustaining with continuous improvement
* Build \& improve mechanisms to ensure all equipment \& processes operate safely, with high availability \& accuracy
* Develop tactical and strategic direction for direct \& skip\-level org that delivers business needs and fosters a strong team culture
* Support 24x7 operations
  

**What You'll Bring*** Degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Experience in welding (MIG \& RSW) and mechanical joining equipment and processes
* Demonstrated experience with automation, robotics, mechanical \& controls systems
* Experience in automotive industry is highly preferred
* Ability to manage and execute multiple large\-scale projects simultaneously, dynamically adjusting priorities to meet changing business needs
* Hands on experience with lean manufacturing principles
* Proven track record to build and lead a strong team in a 24x7 manufacturing environment
